subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@finovo.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really appreciated the deep dive into Finovo's use case and constraints. As discussed, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to kick off alignment across both teams. I pulled together two timeline options so you can share with stakeholders (aggressive vs. conservative), plus a proposed set of milestones, owners, and dependencies.

High-level recap from discovery:
- Goal: 8k-15k tokens/session routing across 3 product flows; latency target < 450ms p95.
- Primary constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC peering requirements, and a pilot environment for performance validation.
- Key internal stakeholders you mentioned: Sam (Engineering sponsor), Priya (Security), Carlos (Procurement) — please confirm.

Attached: Finovo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft with milestones and dates) and short links below to a living Drive copy.

MAP (summary) — please confirm owners and preferred timeline:
1) Requirements sign-off
   - Owner: Finovo (engineering) — RESPONSIBILITY: finalize flows + success criteria
   - Target: Option A (Aggressive): Jan 22, 2026; Option B (Conservative): Feb 5, 2026
   - Dependency: access to example payloads and performance targets

2) Security & Compliance review
   - Owner: Finovo security (Priya) / Redwood security (Rachel) — RESPONSIBILITY: review SOC2 scope, data flow, KMS options
   - Target: Option A: Jan 29, 2026; Option B: Feb 19, 2026
   - Dependency: SOC2 evidence, network diagram, and list of data classification requirements

3) Pilot environment setup (staging VPC)
   - Owner: Redwood infra (Aditya) / Finovo networking (Sam) — RESPONSIBILITY: provision resources, peering, test accounts
   - Target: Option A: Feb 5, 2026; Option B: Feb 26, 2026

4) Pilot run & validation (2-week run)
   - Owner: Joint — RESPONSIBILITY: run representative workload, collect metrics, validate latency/cost
   - Target: Option A: Feb 19, 2026; Option B: Mar 12, 2026

5) Executive review & contract signatures
   - Owner: Finovo procurement (Carlos) / Redwood sales (Marissa) — RESPONSIBILITY: finalize SOW, pricing, and support SLA
   - Target (close): Option A: Mar 1, 2026; Option B: Mar 26, 2026

Ask: Can you confirm the list of stakeholders above (owner per milestone), and which timeline (Aggressive vs. Conservative) you prefer? If Conservative, I'll shift target close to late March. If Aggressive, we'll prioritize security artifacts and fast-track the pilot.

Proposed next steps (if this looks good):
- You confirm stakeholders by EOD Wed (Jan 14)
- I update the MAP and share a living Drive copy + calendar invite for a 30-min MAP kickoff meeting next week
- Redwood will share SOC2 summary & network diagram before the security review

Links/attachments:
- Living MAP: https://drive.google.com/finovo-redwood/MAP_Draft_v1
- Attachment: Finovo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Thanks Marissa — good summary and love that you included two options. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Stakeholders — confirmed:
   - Eng sponsor: Sam Green (me)
   - Security: Priya Singh (pri.singh@finovo.com)
   - Procurement: Carlos Ortega (carlos.ortega@finovo.com)

2) Timeline — prefer the Conservative option given internal resource constraints. Please move target close to week of Mar 23, 2026 (conservative end).

3) Security artifacts — we need the SOC2 report + a network diagram before our security review. Can you share the SOC2 scoping doc and the typical VPC peering diagram?

4) Attachment — I attached our internal risk profile for reference (Finovo_Risk_Profile.pdf).

Would like to schedule the MAP kickoff meeting next Tue (Jan 20) at 10am PT if that works for your team. Assuming Aditya and Rachel can join.
